SYNTHETIC – NOT A REAL PATIENT
He reports onset of low back pain on 06/06/2026. He denies any red flags such as trauma, cancer, fever, weight loss, bladder or bowel symptoms, saddle anesthesia, or progressive neurologic deficit. He started NSAIDs on 06/07/2026 and continues them today. Objective findings include diminished ankle reflex and L5/S1 weakness consistent with radiculopathy. Assessment: Lumbar radiculopathy, likely L5/S1. Plan: Continue NSAIDs, initiate physical therapy, and consider epidural steroid injection after further imaging.
